title: Australian Local Power Agency (Consequential Amendments) Bill 2021
short_title: Australian Local Power Agency (Consequential Amendments) Bill 2021

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would connect the proposed Australian Local Power Agency with existing clean energy bodies through information-sharing powers and liaison arrangements supporting community energy projects.
It would amend the laws governing the Australian Renewable Energy Agency, Clean Energy Finance Corporation and Clean Energy Regulator to recognise the new agency.
The amendments would commence with the separate Australian Local Power Agency legislation, and would not begin if that legislation did not itself commence.
changes: The Australian Renewable Energy Agency could disclose information to the new agency through its existing disclosure framework.
The Clean Energy Finance Corporation could liaise with the agency when performing its investment function.
The corporation could also disclose information to the agency under its existing statutory conditions.
The Clean Energy Regulator could share information with the agency under the regulator's existing disclosure rules.
summary.affected: The proposed agency, Australian Renewable Energy Agency, Clean Energy Finance Corporation and Clean Energy Regulator are affected.

speeches.speaker: Helen Haines
speeches.brief: The bill amends existing clean energy legislation to establish the Australian Local Power Agency as a sister agency to ARENA and the CEFC, forming a trinity to drive renewable energy investment and ensure regional communities benefit.
